item.title: WeChat-Style Conversation Generator for Mockups and Demo Screenshots
item.description:
Try the tool

This small tool can generate WeChat-style conversation screenshots for mockups, demonstrations, or harmless jokes.

Appearance settings: It includes controls for details such as the mobile signal, network status, device time, charging state, battery level, unread-message count, and chat background.

Conversation settings: You can select participants, assign avatars, add red-packet or transfer entries, and set voice-message durations. Notes for red packets and transfers can also be customized. To remove an entry, place the pointer over it and click the red ×, or clear the entire conversation.

item.title: Send a One-Time WeChat Reminder with python and itchat
item.description:
The original script sent a message forever every half-second. That behavior is spam, can harass the recipient, and may cause account restrictions. This safer adaptation sends exactly one message after explicit confirmation and is suitable only for a contact who has agreed to receive the automated reminder.

itchat depends on WeChat web-login behavior that may no longer be available for many accounts, and unofficial automation may conflict with platform terms. Prefer an official API for production use.
